reasons: Cited paragraphs contain no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-inducement covenant binding Corio (our party): Exhibit D §5 is a staffing-assignment commitment, p0116 concerns IP ownership and employee NDA/invention agreements, §14.5 is independent-contractor status, and §14.10 is an integration clause. None restricts hiring or soliciting personnel.

The rule's preferred position is 'No non-solicit on Customer', so absence of such a covenant is correctly classified as compliant rather than missing; no redline or counterparty comment is expected or proposed, consistent with a compliant finding.
The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are inapplicable because there is no non-solicit clause to measure; they do not indicate a defective edit here.

Rationale appropriately flags internally that the incorporated Non-Disclosure Agreement was unavailable and should be checked for a buried non-solicit, and states the fallback position we would hold to if one is later proposed — noted as evidence, not raised as a negotiation issue.
